title: Ōrdō Verbōrum et Stilus Atticus
subtitle: Ōrdō līber (positiō = ēmphasis, nōn fūnctiō grammatica); hyperbaton; stilus periodicus vs. stilus "cōnexus" (Herodotus vs. Thucydidēs/Dēmosthenēs).
objectives: Explicāre cūr ōrdō verbōrum Graecus sit magis līber quam Latīnus/Anglicus, propter systēma cāsuum plēnē marcātum
Recognōscere positiōnem inceptīvam/fīnālem clausulae ut locōs ēmphaticōs
Identificāre hyperbaton (sēparātiōnem verbōrum nātūrāliter iūnctōrum) ut figūram ēmphasis dēlīberātam, nōn errōrem
Distinguere stilum "periodicum" (Thucydidēs, Dēmosthenēs — clausulae balancēs, complexae) ā stilō "cōnexō" (Herodotus — parataxis, clausulae simplicēs iūnctae per καί/δέ)

content.intro: Quia cāsus Graecus (nōn positiō) marcat fūnctiōnem grammaticam (subiectum, obiectum, etc.), ōrdō verbōrum est multō magis LĪBER quam in linguīs positiōne-dēpendentibus (Anglicā, Lūsitānicā moderna) — LĪBER, sed NŌN ARBITRĀRIUS: positiō ipsa portat īnfōrmātiōnem, indicāns ēmphasim/focum. Lēctor Graecus "audit" ēmphasim per ōrdinem, sīcut lēctor Anglicus audit eam per intonātiōnem vōcis.
content.explanation: Prīncipium generāle: verbum in positiōne INCEPTĪVĀ (prīmum in clausulā) vel FĪNĀLĪ (ultimum) tendit portāre ēmphasim maiōrem quam verbum in mediō. Auctor Graecus manipulat ōrdinem dēlīberātē ad focum crēandum — hoc nōn est "licentia poētica" sōlum, sed ūsus normālis etiam in prōsā.

rules.heading: a) Ēmphasis per Positiōnem
rules.body: Comparā: ὁ ἀνὴρ τὸν λόγον εἶπεν. (ōrdō "neutrālis": subiectum-obiectum-verbum) vs. τὸν λόγον ὁ ἀνὴρ εἶπεν. (obiectum praepositum: ēmphasis in "VERBUM", nōn "vir") vs. εἶπεν ὁ ἀνὴρ τὸν λόγον. (verbum praepositum: ēmphasis in āctiōne ipsā "DĪXIT"). Omnēs trēs sunt grammaticē corrēctae — sōlum focus pragmaticus differt.

rules.heading: b) Hyperbaton
rules.body: Hyperbaton est sēparātiō dēlīberāta duōrum verbōrum nātūrāliter iūnctōrum (ut adiectīvum ab nōmine suō) per verba intervenientia, ad crēandum ēmphasim in verbō sēparātō: μεγάλην γὰρ εἶχε τὴν δύναμιν. "Magnam enim habēbat potestātem" (litt. "magnam enim habēbat [pausa] potestātem" — μεγάλην sēparātum ā τὴν δύναμιν per γὰρ εἶχε, intensificāns "magnam"). Nōn est error syntacticus, sed figūra rhētorica dēlīberāta, frequēns apud ōrātōrēs et historicōs.

rules.heading: c) Duo Stilī: Periodicus vs. Cōnexus
rules.body: Stilus "cōnexus" (λέξις εἰρομένη, "strung-together"): clausulae simplicēs, brevēs, iūnctae sequentiāliter per καί/δέ, sine subordinātiōne complexā — patrōnus Herodoteus, magis nārrātīvus/colloquiālis. Stilus periodicus (λέξις κατεστραμμένη): perīodus ("circuitus") sententiae longae, cum multīs clausulīs subordinātīs (participiīs, genetīvīs absolūtīs, clausulīs relātīvīs/condiciōnālibus) balancentibus arte ante attingere verbum prīncipāle/clausulam maiōrem in fine — patrōnus Thucydideus/Dēmosthenicus, magis fōrmālis/architecturālis. Discipulus quī reconhōscit hunc discrīmen stilisticum comprehendet cūr Thucydidēs "vidētur difficilior" quam Xenophōn: nōn grammatica ipsa, sed complexitās architectūrae sententiae.

examples: τὸν λόγον ὁ ἀνὴρ εἶπεν. — Verbum vir dīxit. (obiectum praepositum, ēmphasis in obiectō)
μεγάλην γὰρ εἶχε τὴν δύναμιν. — Magnam enim habēbat potestātem. (hyperbaton, ēmphasis in μεγάλην)
ἦλθον, εἶδον, ἐνίκησα. — Vēnī, vīdī, vīcī. (stilus cōnexus, clausulae breves parallēlae)
ὁ δὲ πόλεμος, ἐπειδὴ ἤρξατο, οὐκέτι ἐπαύσατο, πρὶν ἡ πόλις ἡλῶ. — Bellum autem, postquam coeperat, nōn dēstitit, priusquam urbs capta est. (stilus periodicus, clausulae subordinātae complexae)
καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν ἀπῆλθεν, οἱ δὲ ἔμειναν. — Et haec locūtus discessit, illī vērō mānsērunt. (parataxis, καί/δέ iūnctīvum)
σοφὸς μὲν ὁ ἀνήρ, οὐ μέντοι δίκαιος. — Sapiēns quidem vir, nōn tamen iūstus. (ōrdō emphaticus, μέν praepositum)

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere ōrdinem verbōrum Graecum esse omnīnō arbitrārium/līberum, sine significātiōne pragmaticā.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere ōrdinem verbōrum portat īnfōrmātiōnem ēmphaticam rēalem — positiō inceptīva/fīnālis marcat focum.
commonMistakes.why: Libertās ōrdinis nōn significat vacuitātem sēmanticam; est alius canālis īnfōrmātiōnis, distīnctus ā morphologiā cāsuum.

commonMistakes.wrong: Interpretārī hyperbaton ut errōrem scrīptōris vel corruptiōnem textūs, quaerendō ēmendātiōnem.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere hyperbaton ut figūram rhētoricam dēlīberātam, ūsitātam ad crēandum ēmphasim specificam.
commonMistakes.why: Discipulus incipiēns saepe suppōnit incorrēcte quod verba sēparāta dēbent stāre coniūncta, sīcut in linguā māternā.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere complexitātem syntacticam Thucydidis significāre grammaticam "magis avancātam" vel dīversam ā Xenophonte.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere discrīmen est stilisticum-architectūrāle (perīodus vs. clausulae simplicēs), nōn grammaticum-fundāmentāle.
commonMistakes.why: Utraque auctor adhibet eandem grammaticam fundāmentālem (iam nōtam ā Gradibus I-V); discrīmen difficultātis est organizātiō sententiae, nōn vocābulum morphologicum novum.

options: sēparātiō dēlīberāta verbōrum iūnctōrum, ad ēmphasim

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Ōrdō verbōrum Graecus est omnīnō arbitrārius, sine significātiōne pragmaticā.
items.explanation: Falsum: positiō marcat ēmphasim/focum, nōn est vacua sēmanticē.

items.statement: Positiō inceptīva vel fīnālis in clausulā tendit portāre ēmphasim maiōrem.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: prīncipium generāle ēmphasis per positiōnem.

items.statement: Hyperbaton indicat corruptiōnem textūs vel errōrem scrībae.
items.explanation: Falsum: est figūra rhētorica normālis et dēlīberāta.

items.statement: Thucydidēs et Xenophōn adhibent eandem grammaticam fundāmentālem, differentēs praecipuē in architectūrā sententiārum.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: discrīmen stilisticum, nōn grammaticum novum.

exercises.instructions: Iunge quemque cōnceptum stilisticum cum exemplō suō.

items.explanation: Omnia quattuor sunt aspecta dīversa eiusdem prīncipiī: positiō/ōrdō portant sēnsum, nōn sōlum grammatica cāsuum.

'Εἶπεν ὁ ἀνὴρ τὸν λόγον' (verbum praepositum) pōnit ēmphasim in:

options: adiectīvum ab nōmine suō (vel elementa similiter iūncta)

items.prompt: Discrīmen inter Thucydidem et Xenophontem est:

options: ūnus ex variīs ōrdinibus possibilibus, sine emphasī speciālī

items.statement: Ōrdō verbōrum Graecus est identicus semper, sine variātiōne stilisticā.
items.explanation: Falsum: variat pro emphasī et stilō.

items.statement: Perīodus longa cum clausulīs subordinātīs balancentibus est characteristica stilī cōnexī.
Ambō stilī (periodicus et cōnexus) adhibent eandem grammaticam fundāmentālem Graecam.

summary: Ōrdō verbōrum Graecus est līber (nōn arbitrārius): cāsūs marcant fūnctiōnem, positiō marcat ēmphasim/focum.
Positiō inceptīva/fīnālis in clausulā tendit portāre ēmphasim maiōrem.
Hyperbaton: sēparātiō dēlīberāta verbōrum iūnctōrum, figūra rhētorica intentiōnālis, nōn error.
Stilus cōnexus (Herodotus): clausulae simplicēs, καί/δέ. Stilus periodicus (Thucydidēs/Dēmosthenēs): sententiae complexae, subordinātiō balancēns.
Discrīmen inter auctōrēs "faciliōrēs" et "difficiliōrēs" reflectit saepe architectūram sententiae, nōn grammaticam fundāmentāliter dīversam.
